name: Tracker
description: Lone-wolf survivalist Colter Shaw roams the country as a “reward seeker,” using his expert tracking skills to help private citizens and law enforcement solve all manner of mysteries while contending with his own fractured family.

videos.title: Klamath Falls
videos.overview: Colter investigates the disappearance of 14-year-old Gil Brown, who is suspected to have been taken by his birth dad with a criminal background, and finds himself in some trouble of his own, requiring help from legal mind Reenie Greene.

videos.title: Missoula
videos.overview: Colter tracks down a missing young man who has been pulled into a deadly cult and doesn't want to be found.

videos.title: Springland
videos.overview: As Colter helps a young woman locate her free-spirited sister, he digs deeper into how the sister's last days may lead to a dark secret she unearthed in this tight-knit town.

videos.title: Mt. Shasta
videos.overview: Colter races against the clock to find the missing teenage son of Reenie's close friend Erika.

videos.title: St. Louis
videos.overview: The odds are stacked against Colter as he is tasked by a convicted murderer's teenage daughter to track down a missing witness who could prove her dad's innocence.

videos.title: Lexington
videos.overview: Colter reluctantly teams up with his nemesis, fellow reward seeker Billie Matalon, to track down a missing racehorse.

videos.title: Chicago
videos.overview: Colter, Bobby and Reenie race against time to track down a talented MMA fighter who disappeared while trying to solve her family’s trouble with their visas.

videos.title: Camden
videos.overview: Colter tracks down a dockworker who went missing two weeks before his wedding following a confrontation with his past.

videos.title: Aurora
videos.overview: When a widower offers a reward to find his only daughter who disappeared three years ago and is presumed dead, Colter agrees to help track her down.

videos.title: Into the Wild
videos.overview: Colter journeys into the wilderness of Idaho to help track down the owner of an aerial outfitting company's missing adult children who were last seen in a plane that took off during bad weather with a mysterious client on board.

videos.title: Beyond the Campus Walls
videos.overview: When a grad student goes missing after a house party, his friends and family believe he buckled under the pressure of his research grant. But, after consulting with his sister Dr. Dory Shaw, a professor at the school, Colter uncovers a trail of explicit photos and messages that lead him to uncover a dangerous – and deadly – conspiracy on campus.

videos.title: Off the Books
videos.overview: Colter is forced to team up with his estranged brother, Russell, who enlists his help to track down a former army buddy who's gone missing after several weeks of paranoid behavior. The investigation takes the brothers into the world of Special Forces missions, shady off-the-books programs and conspiracy theories, all while they contend with their family's past.

videos.title: The Storm
videos.overview: Colter investigates the disappearance of two amateur storm chasers, one of whom is the daughter of an old family friend, that the local police have written off as an accidental drowning. Colter's expert tracking skills lead him to uncover the seedy underbelly of a small town resort.

videos.title: Out of the Past
videos.overview: The disappearance of a family in the backwoods of Arkansas leads Colter to a shocking discovery.

videos.title: Ontological Shock
videos.overview: When Colter disappears during his search for a missing father, Reenie recruits his brother Russell for help.

videos.title: Bloodlines
videos.overview: Colter and rival rewardist Billie Matalon team up to find a missing high school baseball star.

videos.title: Noble Rot
videos.overview: Reenie gets Colter to take a case involving a woman missing from a high-end wellness retreat in Napa designed for CEOs.

videos.title: Preternatural
videos.overview: Colter takes a job locating a missing teen with a unique spiritual gift in an inhospitable mining town.

videos.title: Trust Fall
videos.overview: While searching for missing campers, Colter meets a retired police officer who believes a serial killer is on the loose.

videos.title: Man's Best Friend
videos.overview: When Colter finds a lost dog at a gas station in Denver and the dog is subsequently stolen from his truck, Colter makes it his mission to track him down and reunite him with his family.

videos.title: The Night Movers
videos.overview: Colter is tasked with tracking down a "ghost" when hired to find a man who seemingly died in a car accident months earlier. Meanwhile, Colter catches a break in his white whale case.

videos.title: The Disciple
videos.overview: A new lead in Colter's white whale case, the disappearance of Gina Picket, brings him and retired cop Keaton back together to track down a serial killer.

videos.title: Nightingale
videos.overview: After Colter is hired to find a missing singer linked to a violent crime, he discovers his target is a stoic survivalist, not unlike himself.

videos.title: Shades of Gray
videos.overview: While tracking the son of a prominent New Jersey cupcake chain founder, Colter gets thrust into the middle of a violent mafia war.

videos.title: Monster
videos.overview: Colter is hired to find a mother in Ohio who went missing after tucking her son in for the night.

videos.title: Neptune
videos.overview: Colter travels to New York City to find a woman who vanished in the dressing room of an upscale clothing store.

videos.title: Exodus
videos.overview: When a teenage musician vanishes in New Orleans, Colter teams up with a local detective and uncovers a chilling mystery involving dark magic.

videos.title: The Grey Goose
videos.overview: Colter recruits fellow rewardist Billie Matalon to infiltrate a women's prison in order to gain access to critical information that would help track down an escaped prisoner and her hostage.

videos.title: The Mercy Seat
videos.overview: Colter helps an old friend with a search and rescue mission for two missing sisters in the snowy Montana wilderness. Reenie gets a visit from a new client that challenges her morality.

videos.title: Memories
videos.overview: Randy enlists Colter's services for his ex after her best friend goes missing following a night on the town in Reno.

videos.title: Collision
videos.overview: Colter heads to Willow Creek, Mich., after a worried mother hires him to track down her beauty queen daughter, Riley, who vanished while driving home from work. While investigating at the garden center where Riley works, Colter looks into her modeling past and uncovers that she was hiding a major secret.

videos.title: Rules of the Game
videos.overview: Reenie urgently calls Colter for help when Leonard Sharf's assistant gets kidnapped ahead of the launch of his new business. Also, Colter visits his sister, Dory.

videos.title: Echo Ridge
videos.overview: Colter returns to Echo Ridge to investigate a diner owner's disappearance, only to uncover a decades-old kidnapping and a shocking family secret.

videos.title: The Process
videos.overview: As Colter grapples with the shocking truth surrounding his father's death, Russell joins forces with his brother to help track down the missing wife and daughter of one of Reenie's clients. Their reunion finds them mixed up in a chain of events involving a sinister underground operation known as ‘The Process.'

videos.title: Leverage
videos.overview: After discovering they've disrupted a sinister underground operation called "The Process," Colter and Russell must race to find the source behind these chained events and end it once and for all.

videos.title: First Fire
videos.overview: On Halloween night, when a nurse is murdered and arsonist Heston Koontz disappears from a psychiatric facility, Colter follows a trail of unsettling clues to uncover the truth with assistance from local officer Dundee.

videos.title: No Man's Land
videos.overview: When a man disappears in a lawless Arizona desert town, Colter's investigation uncovers a hidden relationship that draws him into a dangerous power struggle – and leaves him facing the hard conditions of the wilderness.

videos.title: The Old Ways
videos.overview: When four teens vanish during a hike in the Santa Cruz Mountains, Colter's search uncovers a hidden agenda behind their journey, leading him to an off-grid community where all their lives are put in danger.

videos.title: Angel
videos.overview: When a crime scene cleaner disappears, Colter discovers her fascination with true crime, which may have led her into dangerous territory. As he follows her trail, Colter uncovers a group of amateur sleuths whose hunt for a killer puts everyone at risk.

videos.title: Eat the Rich
videos.overview: When chasing down leads about his father's past, Colter meets a man desperate to find his daughter who vanished while working a courier route. As Colter retraces his steps, he's pulled into an orbit of a wealthy family and their ruthless fixer, who will stop at nothing to keep their secrets buried.

videos.title: Eurydice
videos.overview: When a grieving mother becomes the prime suspect in her missing daughter's murder, Colter sets out to find the true culprit and prove her innocence.

videos.title: Good Trouble
videos.overview: When Colter's old friend Keaton asks for help finding his former partner, they uncover a trail of bodies and a conspiracy that runs deeper than they could've imagined.

videos.title: The Fallout
videos.overview: Injured and framed for a string of murders, Colter, cut off from Reenie and Randy, must rely on unexpected ally Billie to stop a relentless assassin, uncovering a murky truth where justice and vengeance blur.

videos.title: To the Bone
videos.overview: When an 18-year-old goes missing from his family's restaurant, Colter uncovers the teen's underground fake ID business and the secret life he's been hiding from his parents.

videos.title: Do No Harm
videos.overview: When a doctor vanishes after her shift, Colter uncovers a trail of stolen drugs and disguises revealing a calculated revenge plot.

videos.title: Breakaway
videos.overview: After Baxter, a veteran stuntman, disappears following a risky stunt, his girlfriend, Laura, calls Colter to investigate a B-movie set, uncovering shady producers and a trail that leads into a dangerous underground world.

videos.title: The Field Trip
videos.overview: When a young boy disappears during a school field trip at the aquarium, Colter must navigate a volatile father's desperation to find his son.

videos.title: No Good Deed
videos.overview: Randy enlists Colter's help when one of his closest friends vanishes while under house arrest.

videos.title: Struck
videos.overview: A pregnant wife reaches out to Colter to find her missing husband.

videos.title: Daughters
videos.overview: Colter is hired to find a teen girl who went missing from a friend's house during a tragic triple homicide.

videos.title: Alaskan Wild
videos.overview: While searching for answers about his father, Colter is pulled into a tense case involving a teenage boy's missing parents, uncovering a dangerous situation far more complicated than it first appears.

videos.title: Chain of Custody
videos.overview: Reenie hires Colter to locate the star witness of her and Maxine's lawsuit against a corrupt real estate developer on the eve of trial.

videos.title: Reclamation
videos.overview: Colter's search for a woman who went missing from a rehab facility takes an unexpected turn when he runs into Billie, uncovering a possible link between each of their cases.

videos.title: Chrono Stasis
videos.overview: Colter and Russell unite in a personal mission to uncover their father's mysterious work.

videos.title: The Best Ones
videos.overview: Colter and Russell search for a victim of a nefarious research project.
